description: Create a small spreadsheet whose cells can hold values or formulas that sum referenced cells and rectangular ranges. Example 1: set A1 to 2, then make C3 sum A1 and the range A1:B2; C3 evaluates to 4 because A1 is included twice. Example 2: after setting B2 to 2, the same formula evaluates to 6. Constraints: formulas contain valid cell references and ranges, and formula dependencies contain no cycles.
intuition: Store formulas as counted cell dependencies and evaluate them recursively so later edits to referenced cells are reflected.

brute_force.approach: Expand every formula into a fixed value whenever it is assigned, then scan dependent cells after each update.
brute_force.time: set O(1), get O(1), sum O(range area + affected cells)

optimal.approach: Store each formula as a multiset of referenced cells and recursively compute the current value when queried.
optimal.time: set O(1), get O(dependency graph), sum O(referenced cells + dependency graph)

edge_cases: Repeated cell references contribute repeatedly to the sum.
An unset cell has value zero, and setting a formula cell replaces its old formula.
